title: Understanding Gradient Descent
text: Gradient descent is an optimization algorithm used to minimize the loss function by iteratively moving towards the steepest descent as defined by the negative of the gradient.

title: True Gradient vs. Estimated Gradient
text: The true gradient is the exact derivative of the loss function with respect to the parameters, while the estimated gradient is an approximation based on a subset of data.

title: Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD)
text: SGD uses a single or a few training examples to compute the gradient, which introduces noise and makes it an approximation of the true gradient.

title: Analyzing the Statement
text: Consider whether the average of the estimated gradients over one epoch in SGD equals the true gradient at the initial parameter values.
